scope: All-field degree-only compact rational leading-coordinate theorem, including arbitrary nonunit outer images and growing axis orders. The PF=QWF filtered source relation removes the old axis-order loss. Scalar rational unit one-arm corollary permits an arbitrary opposite arm. No unrestricted endpoint or exact novelty claimed.

uniform_result.hypotheses: Q has nonzero constant; P,Q have total degrees p,r<A and nonzero pure q^p,q^r coefficients; numerator axis order is finite
uniform_result.two_arm_full_fan: O(a^2*(t+d)^2)=O(n^2*(1+d/t)^2), all compatible outer images, unit or nonunit numerators
uniform_result.heavy_endpoint_strip: M<=3t+d or |M-a|<=3t+d; price planes are retained
uniform_result.common_integer_weights: O(a^2*(t+d0)^2), height O(a^2); no axis-order cap or image-membership restriction
uniform_result.scalar_one_arm: O(n^2*(1+d/t+log(a/t))^2), arbitrary compatible opposite and outer images
uniform_result.filtered_outer_identity: P*O=(Q*F)*L in original pure labels; all outer inputs i>=max(2t,t+p) are loops modulo strictly cheaper columns on u>1
uniform_result.nonunit_extension: No matching outer-image factorization or axis-order allowance is needed; only Q is required to be a unit.
uniform_result.growing_axis_family: Both W=q^nu+v, 1<=nu<A, have O(n^2*(1+nu/t)^2) fans with arbitrary compatible outers; nu=O(t) is quadratic.
uniform_result.axis_power_certificate: Retained older membership control q^(nu*t) in W*R_L; unnecessary for the stronger filtered fan bound
uniform_result.geometric_family: W=1+v/(1-q) has compact degree 1 and expanded forward/inverse degrees A-1; both such arms give a quadratic full fan

limits: Both arms require the compact rational triangle hypotheses for the quadratic theorem; one such arm controls its heavy sector.
Nonunit and unit numerators both permit arbitrary compatible outer images in the degree-only bound; no axis-order allowance remains.
The scalar rational one-arm corollary permits arbitrary opposite coefficients and has the displayed logarithmic allowance.
Loop identities and prefix coloops retain original labels; denominator multiplication is an invertible row operation, not an algebra coordinate change.
Small expanded or inverse degree is not assumed; general units need not have compact representations of this form.
Strongest-current novelty, sharp unrestricted growth, actual polynomial fan separation and the original final paper remain unresolved.
